title: Vanishing of the first cohomology of the successive kernels after twisting
statement: Let $A$ be a Noetherian ring [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring], $I\subseteq A$ an ideal, $f:X\to\operatorname{Spec}(A)$ a proper morphism [def-weil-proper-morphism], and $\mathcal L$ an invertible $\mathcal O_X$-module [def-sc-invertible-module] which is ample on $X$ in the absolute sense of Stacks Properties Definition 01PS [def-weil-pbc-ample-invertible-module] (since $\operatorname{Spec}(A)$ is affine, this is the same as $\mathcal L$ being $f$-ample, Stacks Morphisms Lemma 01VK; write $\mathcal L^{\otimes d}$ for the $d$-fold tensor product [def-pur-sheaf-tensor-product]). Let $\mathcal I=I\mathcal O_X\subseteq\mathcal O_X$ be the ideal sheaf generated by $I$, i.e. the image of $f^*\widetilde I\to f^*\mathcal O_{\operatorname{Spec}A}\to\mathcal O_X$ [def-nagata-extended-ideal], [def-pc-module-pullback], where $\widetilde I\subseteq\mathcal O_{\operatorname{Spec}A}$ is the quasi-coherent ideal associated with $I$ [lem-weil-pbc-spec-module-tilde-sections]. Let $(\mathcal F_n)_{n\ge1}$ be an object of $\mathit{Coh}(X,\mathcal I)$ [def-weil-pbc-coherent-formal-module], and put $\mathcal F_0=0$. Then there is an integer $d_0$ such that $H^1(X,\operatorname{Ker}(\mathcal F_{n+1}\to\mathcal F_n)\otimes_{\mathcal O_X}\mathcal L^{\otimes d})=0$ for every $n\ge0$ and every $d\ge d_0$, where $H^1$ is sheaf cohomology [pqf-def-cohomology].

proof.text: Properness over Spec(A) supplies IsNoetherian X by isNoetherian_of_locallyOfFiniteType [lem-weil-pbc-finite-type-over-noetherian]. For every F_n, its coherence in [def-weil-pbc-coherent-formal-module] implies quasi-coherence by [pqf-lem-coherent-ft-locnoeth]. Kernel quasi-coherence [lem-weil-pbc-quasi-coherent-module-kernel] gives quasi-coherence of every piece K_n, with K_0=F_1 [def-weil-pbc-formal-kernel-graded-pieces].

Obtain the finite polynomial algebra action and finite local degree-zero generators from [lem-weil-pbc-formal-kernel-polynomial-action]. The algebra is the concrete MvPolynomial (Fin r) A with its homogeneousSubmodule grading. Mathlib MvPolynomial.decomposition and DirectSum.Decomposition.isInternal prove the internal grading; isHomogeneous_one, IsHomogeneous.mul and isHomogeneous_C prove the unit, multiplication and scalar grading laws. Algebra.FiniteType is the standard instance for finitely many variables. Insert degree zero for every generator, using Submodule.span_mono to put the generating span into the general shifted-generator span.

Apply [lem-weil-pbc-formal-systems-graded-vanishing] with the polynomial algebra, G_n=K_n, the action and finite generators of step 2, f and the ample invertible L [def-weil-pbc-ample-invertible-module]. Take p=1 and regard its natural bound d_0 as an integer; exact_mod_cast converts the inequality back to naturals. This proves vanishing of H^1(X,(coproduct K_n) tensor L^d).

For each n construct pi_n from the coproduct by Sigma.desc, using the identity in degree n and zero in all other degrees. Sigma.ι_desc proves iota_n followed by pi_n is the identity. Apply the composite functor tensorRight(L.tensorPow d) followed by RingedSpace.moduleCohomology [def-sc-ringed-space-module-cohomology]. Its functor laws turn this retraction into a retraction on cohomology. The mapped inclusion has zero target by step 3, hence is zero; thus the identity of the summand cohomology is zero. IsZero.iff_id_eq_zero proves the desired conclusion, including n=0. Tensoring is the source monoidal tensor product [def-pur-sheaf-tensor-product].

lead_note: L (2026-10-10): the citation of def-sc-ample (ample over a field) does not fit a scheme over Spec A; the absolute notion is def-weil-pbc-ample-invertible-module (Stacks 01PS), and over an affine base f-ample is the same as ample (01VK). The splitter of this node should restate ampleness through that node so that lem-weil-pbc-coherent-twist-global-generation applies.

split_report.summary: Ampleness repaired as the lead_note asks: def-sc-ample (proper schemes over a field) replaced by def-weil-pbc-ample-invertible-module (Stacks 01PS), with the remark that over the affine base Spec A this is f-ampleness (Morphisms 01VK); this is exactly what the citer lem-weil-pbc-grothendieck-existence-projective supplies (via lem-weil-pbc-projective-ample-invertible) and what lem-weil-pbc-coherent-twist-global-generation needs. Statement made explicit: I O_X defined via def-nagata-extended-ideal and the tilde of I; F_0 = 0 convention stated for n = 0 (Coh(X,I) is indexed n >= 1); stmt_deps now list the notions only (the two lemmas kernel-rees-finite and graded-vanishing moved to proof_deps; def-pur-sheaf-tensor-product, def-nagata-extended-ideal, def-pc-module-pullback, lem-weil-pbc-spec-module-tilde-sections added; def-sc-ample removed). Proof in six steps following Stacks 0884: X Noetherian; B = (+) I^n/I^{n+1} finitely generated; a surjection f^*B~ -> (+) I^n O_X / I^{n+1} O_X (Stacks writes an equality, false e.g. for X = Spec A/I); the kernels form a finite type graded module (087Z node); 0897 (2) node; retract argument for each summand. No new nodes; all cited nodes existed. Mathlib searched again (leansearch, leanfinder, grep): no ample sheaves, no coherent cohomology.
